title: Colts re-signed WR Alec Pierce ‘knew his heart was in Indianapolis’—and best is still yet to come

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts re-signed WR Alec Pierce ‘knew his heart was in Indianapolis’—and best is still yet to come
sources.description: It appears as though Colts re-signed wideout Alec Pierce never actually wanted to leave—even turning down money to stay in Indianapolis, and finish the job.
